hypothesis: Blind geothermal faults missing from the USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue express as coincident geophysical edges (magnetic/gravity/topo gradients, tilt curvature), seismicity and conductivity without a mapped surface trace.  Dots placed off-catalogue and outside all registry halos target those unseen structures while being unique by construction.
mechanism: Equal-weight rank composite of rtp/tmi (magnetite destruction, mag lows), tmi_hg/iso_grav_anom_hg (source edges), ieq_n100a15 (seismicity), cond_surf (fluids), det_elev_slope (scarps), restricted to footprint pixels >5 px from catalogue and outside the 3-px halo of every GEMSDOE24/25/27/28/30/31/32/33/36 raster. Greedy 3-px NMS emits the top dots.
named_non_fault_mimic: Pluvial Lake Lahontan shoreline berms, TIGER road/rail embankments, alluvial fan edges and conductive playas can mimic lineament/edge signals; mitigated by equal-weight multi-sensor fusion (no single mimic drives all bands) and by ranking rather than thresholding.
